site_name: 65 Muswell Hill Place, Hornsey, London, N10 3RP
description:
Lawful development: Proposed use. 
I consider that the works are lawful as they fall within the scope of permitted development rights under Class D, Part 1 of Schedule 2 to the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).

The porch extension/alteration meets all of the following conditions:
Ground Floor Area: The ground floor area of the porch, measured externally, is less than 3 square metres.
Maximum Height: The highest part of the porch is less than 3 metres above ground level.
Highway Boundary: The porch is located more than 2 metres from the highway boundary of the dwellinghouse.
Heating: Thermally separated from the dwelling by existing external-quality wall and door. The heating system is not extended into the porch.
Dwelling Status: The property is a standard dwellinghouse and is not a flat, maisonette, or other building for which permitted development rights have been removed.
